title: Middle Eastern Tequenos Skewers
description: A unique twist on traditional tequenos, these Middle Eastern skewers are crispy on the outside and deliciously savory on the inside.
instructions: Cut the lamb kofta into bite-sized pieces and season with salt, black pepper, and garlic powder.
Wrap each piece of lamb with a piece of crispy pastry dough, pressing the edges to seal.
Place the tequenos on the eastern skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the tops of the tequenos with lemon juice and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the lamb is cooked through.
Note: If cooking on a grill, cook for 5-7 minutes per side, or until the pastry is golden brown and the lamb is cooked through.
